summary: The filing reports the unregistered sale of limited partnership units by Stonepeak-Plus Infrastructure Fund LP to third-party investors for aggregate consideration of approximately $23.9 million on May 4, 2026, with finalization on May 29, 2026. Units were sold at per-unit transactional NAV (e.g., Class A-1a at $32.04). The sales were part of a continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. No special-situation event is triggered—this is a routine capital raise by an investment fund.
